response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT original_language_id, AVG(rental_rate) AS avg_rate, COUNT(*) AS films FROM film WHERE rental_duration > 5 GROUP BY original_language_id) SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS avg_of_group_avg_rates, AVG(films) AS avg_of_group_film_counts FROM g;

assumptions.assumption: "More than 5 days" means strictly greater than 5, so only rental_duration values 6 and 7 qualify.
Films with NULL original_language_id form one group. GROUP BY places NULLs together, so this is handled without a special case.
Each group's average rate and film count are computed over the filtered films, and the outer AVG treats every group equally. AVG ignores NULLs, and it returns NULL if no groups remain.
